items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: I remember what I had done for him and also wishing me well in my music career.

ctx.x: Not that I remember, but I got a loving cup here. And I don't know what ever happened. It was stolen from the U.S. And the U.S. And the U.S.

Oakland I remember what I had done for him and also wishing me well in my music career. It must have been about two and a half feet high. So tall and not about a program. It's silver cup. It could go in a line. And being so young, I just let it get away from it. Would have been a great one. He's from the half to the half.
How do you spell his name?
